_note: SYNTHETIC taxonomy for a fictional project-management app. Not derived from any real product taxonomy.

problem_areas.name: Boards & Cards
problem_areas.description: Creating, moving, or editing cards and columns on a board.

problem_areas.name: Calendar Sync
problem_areas.description: Two-way sync between tasks and external calendars.

problem_areas.name: Notifications
problem_areas.description: In-app, email, or push notifications: delivery, timing, content.

problem_areas.name: Search
problem_areas.description: Global search and filters: missing, stale, or wrong results.

problem_areas.name: Import & Export
problem_areas.description: CSV/XLSX import, export files, and migration tools.

problem_areas.name: Billing
problem_areas.description: Plans, invoices, seat counts, and payment flows.

problem_areas.name: Other (Needs Classification)
problem_areas.description: Fallback when no area fits. Never auto-applied.

problem_types.name: Functional Defect
problem_types.description: A feature does not behave as specified.

problem_types.name: Regression
problem_types.description: Behaviour that previously worked is broken after a change.

problem_types.name: Performance
problem_types.description: Slowness, timeouts, or excessive resource use.

problem_types.name: Data Integrity
problem_types.description: Data is lost, duplicated, or inconsistent between views.

problem_types.name: Integration
problem_types.description: Failure at a boundary with a third-party system.

problem_types.name: Permissions
problem_types.description: A user can see or do something they should not, or vice versa.

problem_types.name: Other
problem_types.description: Fallback when no type fits. Never auto-applied.
